entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioner files a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition.

2. The memo reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL

It is submitted that, the petitioner in this petition has challenged the proceedings in S.C.No.23/2022, arising out of Crime No.24/2022 for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 304B r/w. 34 of IPC and Section 3, 4 of D.P.ACT pending before the Honble Prl. District Judge and Sessions Judge,
Chikkaballapura.

entities.text:
Prl. District Judge and Sessions Judge,
Chikkaballapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: During the pendency of this Criminal Petition, the trial Court was pleased to acquit the petitioner / accused in the alleged offences in SC No.23/2022 vide its Judgment dated 19.04.2024.

In view of the above, the prayer of the Petitioner in this Criminal Petition is become infructuous, therefore this Hon'ble Court may please to permit the petitioner to withdraw this petition as not pressed in the interest of Justice and Equity."
In terms of the memo, the criminal petition is disposed as withdrawn.
I.A.No.1/2022 is disposed, as a consequence.

Sd/-
